answer.rationale: Roll out the confirmed shortened onboarding flow to self-serve SMBs to make value visible sooner during the price-pressure period. It improved completion, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, aligning with sustainable qualified revenue. Avoid broad promotional pricing because its acquisition lift came with material retention damage. Monitor retention and qualified revenue closely because the related signup-simplification result showed a small retention decline and neither result directly tests a competitor price-cut shock.
